extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: roman racing chariot without horses, approx. 1.8 m wide, 3.1 m long incl. pole, 1.4 m high, wheels 92 cm
extras.notes: light roman circus racing chariot: D shaped wooden floor, high red breastwork falling towards the open back with a gold hand rail, gold trim and a gold rosette at the front, axle under the back of the car, two eight spoked wheels with bronze tyres and hub caps ('racing-chariot_wheel_l', 'racing-chariot_wheel_r', not baked, origin at the hub, rotate about X), draught pole sloping to the ground with a plain yoke beam resting on the ground; front (pole) faces -Y; no horses, no weapons, no figures

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
